question: Which categories of śrāddha rites are enumerated in this classification?
premises: Śrāddha rites are classified by purpose and occasion.
Daily, occasional, desire-driven, prosperity, and fortnightly types are named.
The list presents distinct ritual categories.
inference: The verse enumerates five types of śrāddha: daily, occasional, desire-driven, prosperity, and fortnightly.
plain_english: The types are daily, occasional, desire-driven, prosperity, and indeed the fortnightly rite.
